project_overview.vibe: Apple × Dior Beauty × Aesop × Charlotte Tilbury × Luxury Medical Clinic
project_overview.aesthetic: Clean, feminine, luxurious, expensive feel. Matte White, Warm Ivory, Soft Beige, Champagne Gold accents, Charcoal typography.

rules: Headings MUST use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter).
No 'Inter' or generic sans for headings.
H1 must be expressive and large (up to text-6xl+ with fluid clamp), but not excessively huge.
Avoid pure white #FFFFFF for backgrounds, use Warm Ivory #FDFBF7 or Matte White #FAFAFA.
No full-screen glossy gradients. Use subtle noise/grain texture.
Text must maintain high contrast ratio.

layouts.grids: The 'Bento' Grid Protocol - Mode A (Tetris Grid) for marketing. Asymmetry is mandatory.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. p-8 to p-24, gap-8 to gap-16.
layouts.hero: Massive editorial kinetic hero, no centered templates.
rules: Do not use Bootstrap-style standard equal columns.
Overlap elements slightly to create depth.
Ensure borders have internal padding to prevent text collision.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Glassmorphism for sticky headers (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70, 1px white/20 border, shadow-sm). Flat/soft shadow surfaces for cards.
visual_enhancers.motion: Framer Motion for scroll reveals, Lenis for momentum smooth scrolling.
visual_enhancers.marquee: Slow editorial ribbon (react-fast-marquee). Pale background, dark text, gap-24.

components.header: Sticky navigation (z-50), backdrop-blur glassmorphism. 'Book Consultation' CTA always visible.
components.floating_cta: Large floating booking button anchored to bottom right. Triggers Shadcn demo booking modal.
components.treatments: Featured treatments showcased elegantly, avoiding repetitive standard card grids.
components.manifesto: Numbered manifesto chapters with elegant typography and asymmetrical alignment.
components.journey: Animated timeline for the Treatment Journey.
components.faq: Luxury FAQ accordion with smooth animations.
components.footer: Premium massive footer with large typography.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for normal text, 3:1 for large text.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='book-consultation-nav-btn').

media.rules: Treat photography deliberately: spotlight effects, clipped frames, intentional styling. DO NOT use placeholder images.

3d_libraries.usage: Subtle parallax/3D hero moment showcasing floating luxury skincare bottles, gold rings, or cosmetic particles.
3d_libraries.lighting: Provide adequate ambient light and Environment preset to ensure 3D elements look premium and not flat or muddy.

instructions_to_main_agent: Add 'Playfair Display' and 'DM Sans' to your Google Fonts link in index.html.
Configure custom colors in tailwind.config.js for Warm Ivory (#FDFBF7), Matte White (#FAFAFA), Champagne Gold (#D4AF37), Charcoal (#1A1A1A).
Use Lenis on the root application component to enable smooth scrolling globally.
Hero MUST include masked line-by-line reveal using Framer Motion (`overflow-hidden` wrappers around text lines).
Never use fully transparent backgrounds for the sticky header; use backdrop-blur with a semi-transparent white/ivory base.
Build the Before & After section using an interactive slider component.
Implement Shadcn UI for the demo booking modal triggered by a floating CTA.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: DO NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). This breaks Framer Motion transforms.
DO NOT center align the app container in CSS. No `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical (e.g. py-24 or py-32 for sections). Cramped designs look cheap.
NEVER use placeholder text for images/logos. Use the provided Unsplash URLs.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, focus states).
All interactive elements MUST HAVE a `data-testid` attribute.
